manaNeeded: {2}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional sorcery
notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
You have a sorcery card in hand.
description:
Cast the additional sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Alania triggers; choose not to have an opponent draw a card.
Holding priority, cast Wild Ricochet by paying {2}{R}{R}, targeting the additional sorcery.
Alania triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and you to copy Wild Ricochet, with the copy targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Resolve the copy of Wild Ricochet, copying the original Wild Ricochet, with the copy targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Repeat step 5.
